title: Aftermath of the Bay of Pigs invasion, 20 April 1961 – U-2 aerial photo
description: Aerial reconnaissance photograph of a coastline with a road running along the shore and scattered light patches, captioned "Aftermath of the Bay of Pigs invasion, 20 April 1961." Chapter 5 text (page 199) below covers U-2 in-flight refueling with KC-135 tankers and the start of the section "U-2 Coverage During the Cuban Missile Crisis."
